about_the_game:
Welcome to Schrödinger's Maze – an adventure set in a world of quantum vision!

In this maze, only what’s within your line of sight truly exists. Everything beyond it falls into a quantum superposition—caught between existence and oblivion.
A single step can flip your reality: what appears to be a wall might be an illusion; what seems like an enemy could be a hidden treasure or a key!

Shift your perspective to clear the fog of uncertainty. When all paths seem blocked, change your view—a new way forward may reveal itself where none seemed to exist.

🧩 Combat follows a tower-style strategy system:
Absorb gems, unlock chests, upgrade gear, activate your skill tree, and defeat powerful bosses as you gradually unlock your quantum potential.
Ultimately, become the one who uncovers the true nature of the Maze.

🔥 Special Crossover Event: Schrödinger’s Maze × Dungeon of the Magic Tower Now Live!

All characters unlocked in Dungeon of the Magic Tower are now fully playable in Schrödinger’s Maze!
With over 30 unique characters to choose from, build your own multiverse exploration team and dive into the unknown!
